method_note: Each point is the capital-region address register point (Seudullinen osoiteluettelo / Regional Address List, WFS layer avoindata:PKS_osoiteluettelo, published by the City of Helsinki with data produced by the cities of Helsinki, Espoo, Vantaa and Kauniainen from address decisions and land-use plans) for the street address Equinix gives for the IBX on its own facility page (Internet Archive raw copies of 3 October 2026; www.equinix.com answers robots.txt with HTTP 403, so the live pages were not requested). For each address two queries were captured: the whole street in the register's native CRS EPSG:3879 (ETRS-GK25) and the exact street-and-number filter served in EPSG:4326. The locator is the served EPSG:4326 point exactly as returned (GeoJSON [longitude, latitude]); the native EPSG:3879 point was transformed independently with pyproj 3.7.1 / PROJ 9.5.1 (always_xy, EPSG:3879 -> EPSG:4326) and agrees within a few millimetres. No geocoding beyond the official register query, no offsets and no rounding were applied. The latitude/longitude constants in the map widget scripts of Equinix's pages were not read for the locator or used as a check, and no commercial map, map embed, short link, PeeringDB record or OpenStreetMap service was used.

register_metadata.title: Seudullinen osoiteluettelo (Pääkaupunkiseudun osoiteluettelo) / Regional Address List
register_metadata.licence: Seudullinen avoimen tietoaineiston lisenssi 1.0 (regional open-data licence of the Helsinki capital region)
register_metadata.scope_note: The metadata states that the list holds the street addresses of properties, plots and plan units, not apartment-specific or postal addresses, and that a division letter is added to an address number only when a property has been divided; staircase or entrance letters such as the operator's 'B' are therefore not register entries.

site_versus_campus_review: Equinix HE3, HE4 and HE5 are separate physical sites: Equinix lists them as separate IBX data centres with separate street addresses (Parrukatu 2, Helsinki; Myllynkivenkuja 4B, Vantaa; Sahamyllyntie 4B, Helsinki) and separate colocation-space figures, and the register points are 4.117 km (HE3-HE5), 13.109 km (HE3-HE4) and 10.662 km (HE4-HE5) apart (WGS84 geodesic). Equinix HE6 (Sinimäentie 12, Espoo) and HE7 (Sinimäentie 8, Espoo) are separate Equinix IBXs about 212 m apart in Espoo; they are not part of these records and are held in this fragment.
